invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破0.089（ATR止损），或融资费率Z-score回升至-20%以上（轧空风险解除）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 0.089 (ATR stop-loss), or funding Z-score rises above -20% (short squeeze risk dissipates).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格突破2080（阻力位），或融资费率Z-score降至20%以下（轧多风险解除）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks above 2080 (resistance level), or funding Z-score drops below 20% (long squeeze risk dissipates).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破69500（基于ATR止损），或融资费率Z-score回升至-20%以上（轧空风险解除）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 69500 (based on ATR stop-loss), or funding Z-score rises above -20% (short squeeze risk dissipates).
